decision: Deploy the source-main single lineage to Production while preserving the accepted GI-088 v1.9 experience and the Stage 1-4 contracts.

scope: Production candidate deployment from the exact current main source
evidence closeout, commit, push, pull request, and merge

roles.objectiveChecks: Verify exact deployment, runtime identity, one visible response, one background fact task, one user message, one assistant message, no pending turn, and complete temporary-data cleanup.
roles.codexReview: Assess the controlled response against the already accepted v1.9 contract and report pass, minor, or fail.
roles.productOwner: Authorized this Production release and retains final product authority for any plan expansion.

stopPoints: candidate source or deployment identity mismatch
runtime mode, strategy, or model mismatch
invalid visible response or missing background task
permission, consent, daily-journal, recovery, or idempotency regression
